title: Feature request: read historic BZ measurements of FreeStyle Libre App into xDrip
body: Situation: Freestyle App does not collect sensor data, eg. mobile device is out of range. Manual read by NFC with Freestyle does not only read actual BZ Value, also historic data of last 8hrs, too. Those mesaurements should also be transfered into xDrip

comments.body:
this is not (initial)  a topic of xDrip. The problem is, that the patch for
the librelink app does not contain the ability to send the historic data.
So before xDrip could handle this historic data, someone needs to
enhance the patch to make them available. But at the moment I see nobody
who will dive into the mashinecode of librelinkl to make that possible...
